_doc: M1 slice (0-44.9s) rebuilt the SHORT's way: multi-panel comic GRIDS via the LOCKED comic_engine.py (now 16:9-capable via set_page), a DISTINCT still per panel, `full` reserved for the two sacred red-letter singles. Same beats/captions as m1_fastcut.json so it is an apples-to-apples A/B vs the flat full-frame fastcut. Templates chosen for WIDE 16:9 stills (big_inset/stack_h/quad preserve horizontal comp; two_v/triptych_v avoided — they crop wide stills to a vertical strip). $0 static preview: existing 21 stills only, no Kling. narration.mp3 reused.
_motion_note: animated clips carry a directional motion (pushin/pullback) so comic_engine slow-forwards them; scribe_over_manuscripts stays static (writing -> ken-burns, never Kling-animated).

cap.text: Nailed to a Roman cross, he cried into the dark.
My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
cap.speaker: JESUS

cap.text: Written down a thousand years before.
By a king who died old and safe in his own bed.
Why art thou so far from helping me?
cap.speaker: PSALM 22
